detection:
    selection:
        - ParentImage|endswith:
              - '.doc.lnk'
              - '.docx.lnk'
              - '.xls.lnk'
              - '.xlsx.lnk'
              - '.ppt.lnk'
              - '.pptx.lnk'
              - '.rtf.lnk'
              - '.pdf.lnk'
              - '.txt.lnk'
              - '.doc.js'
              - '.docx.js'
              - '.xls.js'
              - '.xlsx.js'
              - '.ppt.js'
              - '.pptx.js'
              - '.rtf.js'
              - '.pdf.js'
              - '.txt.js'
        - ParentCommandLine|contains:
              - '.doc.lnk'
              - '.docx.lnk'
              - '.xls.lnk'
              - '.xlsx.lnk'
              - '.ppt.lnk'
              - '.pptx.lnk'
              - '.rtf.lnk'
              - '.pdf.lnk'
              - '.txt.lnk'
              - '.doc.js'
              - '.docx.js'
              - '.xls.js'
              - '.xlsx.js'
              - '.ppt.js'
              - '.pptx.js'
              - '.rtf.js'
              - '.pdf.js'
              - '.txt.js'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Unknown
level: high
